name: 蛋黄注心爆浆小蛋糕款
description: 金黄软糯注心小蛋糕，咬开爆浆流心，早餐零食两相宜

styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft cream #FDF4DC for info and scene shots, seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec shots, one golden amber #F5B52A closing panel; soft rounded shapes only
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm top light around 5000K with gentle front fill, soft gradient falloff, soft contact shadows grounding the product, appetizing matte texture, never harsh or plastic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm light wood table #D9B382 for scenes, matte cream board #F7EAD0 for infographics, white ceramic plate for product close-ups
styleLock.typography: rounded friendly sans-serif for all headline and label text, warm brown #6B4226 on cream or #FFFFFF on amber
styleLock.iconSystem: simple rounded food doodle icons in #F5B52A only, thin and minimal
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the product across the set, cakes always shown fresh with soft crumb and glossy filling, consistent scale
styleLock.lockText: {style_lock} consistent warm appetizing bakery snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft cream background #FDF4DC, golden amber accent #F5B52A, yolk-orange secondary accent #FF9D2E and warm brown text #6B4226; soft warm top lighting around 5000K with gentle gradient falloff and soft contact shadows, appetizing matte food texture that never looks plastic; rounded friendly sans-serif for all headline and label text; consistent rounded label and badge shapes; consistent minimal rounded food doodle icons; clean food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food texture.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level at a slight 3/4 angle, full product visible and not clipped
shots.lighting: soft warm top light around 5000K with gentle front fill, soft contact shadow grounding the product
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a small round filled snack cake. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 angle, full product visible and not clipped by the frame, the cake filling 60-70% of the frame with its soft contact shadow completing the composition. Soft warm top light around 5000K with a gentle front fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product so it never floats. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Appetizing matte baked cake texture in a warm golden #F5B52A tone with visible soft crumb, never plastic. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no plastic-looking surface.

shots.intent: 一秒传达咬开爆浆流心的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight low angle looking upward about 20 degrees, product on the left third, one cake broken open showing the filling
shots.lighting: soft warm top light around 5000K, gentle accent light on the filling, soft contact shadow
shots.background: soft cream #FDF4DC with a subtle golden amber wave edge at the bottom
shots.props: one minimal rounded doodle icon in #F5B52A
shots.textZone: right-side text column: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one sub label 「{callout_1}」 in #6B4226, one minimal rounded doodle icon in #F5B52A
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}, a small round filled snack cake with one piece broken open showing flowing filling in a warm golden #F5B52A tone. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a slight low angle looking upward about 20 degrees, the product occupying 50-60% on the left two-thirds. The right side carries a vertical text column with one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one sub label 「{callout_1}」 in #6B4226, plus one minimal rounded doodle icon in #F5B52A, the pastries and the text column together filling the full frame. Background soft cream #FDF4DC with a subtle golden amber wave edge at the bottom, soft warm top light around 5000K with a gentle accent light on the filling, soft contact shadow. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented ingredient or efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 用断面拉丝流心证明注心工艺与松软质地
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, shallow depth of field f/2.8, filling sharp in the foreground
shots.lighting: raking warm side light from the left revealing moist crumb and glossy filling, soft warm tone around 5000K
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} broken in half, tight zoom on the cross-section showing the warm golden #F5B52A filling slowly flowing from the soft moist crumb. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, shallow depth of field with the filling sharp in the foreground. Raking warm side light from the left revealing the moist crumb texture and glossy filling, warm tone around 5000K, appetizing and natural. Cream background #FDF4DC softly blurred, keeping only a shallow out-of-focus depth behind the cut face, the flowing filling itself is the subject and fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-like filling, no stiff or rubbery texture, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 代入早餐与下午茶场景，唤起自用与囤货欲
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down over a breakfast table
shots.lighting: soft natural morning window light from the left around 5500K, long soft shadows, soft contact shadow
shots.props: a glass of milk and a folded linen napkin, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} arranged on a #FFFFFF ceramic plate beside a glass of milk on a warm light wood breakfast table #D9B382, the plate, milk glass and folded napkin composing a full breakfast vignette that fills the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down. Soft natural morning window light from the left around 5500K, long soft shadows and a soft contact shadow grounding the plate. Props: a glass of milk and a folded linen napkin, not covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with the breakfast props composing the rest, no text anywhere. Fresh appetizing food texture, natural and believable. Negative: no visible people, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no messy clutter, no impossible shadows.

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: dimension callout lines and filled rounded label chips in #6B4226 and #F5B52A
shots.textZone: structured spec layout: core promise 「{callout_1}」, two short spec labels 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」, one rounded amber spec chip #F5B52A carrying 「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level front view: one unwrapped cake beside one generically wrapped piece whose wrapper carries no readable text or logo. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Pure white background #FFFFFF. Structured clean layout with dimension callout lines in #6B4226, a core promise 「{callout_1}」 and two short spec labels 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」, plus one rounded amber spec chip #F5B52A carrying 「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF, every chip and line fully filled so the layout reads complete. shots.lighting: identical soft warm top light around 5000K across all variants, soft contact shadows
shots.textZone: one short flavor label under each cake 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #6B4226

provenance.notes: 从 5 张蛋黄注心小蛋糕爆款详情切片提炼：白底/卖点开场、断面微距、金黄表皮与松软质地、食材圈版式、包装与促销位。已剥离源品牌（源图包装已打码）、二维码、促销贴片（加入会员等）及全部原文案；保质期、配料表等源数据一律不带入，不可验证的信任元素（印章徽章、认证标识）一律省略，信任镜改用食材平铺等可验证视觉细节。shot-05 规格图、shot-07 多口味矩阵与 shot-08 CTA 为按食品品类漏斗惯例做的版式补全（源切片不足 5 张对应镜位，shot-03 的草莓味变体在源图 panel-03 中可见，支持 VARIANT 合理性）。
